verdict.rationale: There is a public GitHub repository (github.com/yylo-dev/yylo) whose README describes the CLI orchestrator, which suggests the source can be read. However, nothing in the pack names a license or confirms the full source is published there. The 'open-standard path' mention refers to installing skills, not to licensing. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache), confirmation that the full product source rather than only docs is in the repo, and independent corroboration of the license terms.
